source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C28-owned source/fixture/generated path bytes, NUL separators and each file SHA-256; excludes plans/progress.json, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json and docs/evidence/ to avoid recursive self-reference
